Views, charm, livability, convenience, all in one attractive home. Multiple west-facing decks deliver a commanding perspective over Ballard with the Olympic Mountains as a backdrop, the perfect setting for watching the seasons change. Inside, 1926 character meets thoughtful updates. The front room features a perfect-blue color wash, period wood-burning fireplace and built-ins, and open dining room with plentiful windows and stylish lighting. The remodeled kitchen is efficient and bespoke, with quartz counters, white shaker cabinetry, subway tile, stainless appliances, a Fisher & Paykel range, and a sunny breakfast nook with heated terracotta floor. Two bedrooms and a full bath complete the main level. Upstairs, find a generous primary bedroom with ensuite bath and a guest bedroom with built-in shelving and westerly view; this could double as an office space. The finished lower level adds valuable bonus space for a rec room, media room, home office, or play area. Outside, a fully fenced yard with patio, pergola, and terraced garden invites easy outdoor living. Just steps to West Woodland Elementary and a few blocks to the shops, restaurants, and pubs of Ballard and Phinney Ridge, this is a laid-back Seattle neighborhood where life happens outdoors and neighbors know each other.

Welcome to this is incredible opportunity to restore, renovate or expand this inherently attractive full brick Tudor in the highly desirable Whittier Heights community! This property presents very pleasant curb appeal. The interior's main level shows 2 bedrooms, a full bath, hardwood oak floors, coved ceilings and a classic fireplace. There is a rec room/flex room on the upper level. The lower level offers a blank slate, unfinished, providing easy access to all of the systems. This home dwells on an oversized and level 5,588 square foot lot (RKC) with alley access. The location of the property is simply excellent. It is just one block away from Whittier Heights Elementary school, numerous parks, shopping and transportation. Bring your toolbelt, your paintbrush and your imagination! There is deferred maintenance throughout this home. It is being offered to buyers with a vision to revitalize and/or develop. The seller is seeking a cash offer with no financing contingency. The property is to be sold As-Is. This is a truly great and rare opportunity!

Perched above the street in coveted Sunset Hill, this home offers breathtaking Puget Sound views. A masterful remodel perfectly balances the original character with high-end modern comforts. Inside, you'll delight in soaring 14 foot ceilings and an abundance of natural light. The chef's kitchen is at the heart of the home, boasting a professional six-burner range and a generous island that anchors the open floor plan. Whether you're enjoying a formal dinner in the dining area or lounging in the sitting room off the kitchen, the flow is effortless. The upper level feels like a retreat with generous bedrooms, ample storage, a large bathroom and spectacular Sound views. With 4 bedrooms and multiple areas to lounge, there is plenty of flexibility to work from home and host guests. The lower level adds even more versatility, serving as a media room, gym, or guest space. Seamless indoor-outdoor access makes year-round entertaining easy. Don't miss the delightful garden out back right off the sitting room with its ample deck and thoughtful landscaping. The attached garage and additional storage areas are perfect for stowing outdoor gear or a growing wine collection. Significant updates include a full upper-floor addition, updated appliances, radiant heating, and Trex decking. Minutes to everything Ballard has to offer including countless eateries, Golden Gardens and the Ballard Locks! Don't miss this gem!

Beach club membership not required. The water is yours and the afternoon changes shape. At 647 NW 51st Street, a private swimming pool turns a classic Ballard home into The Frelard Pool House, enriched by a cabana and dressing area, private guest suite, wet bar, entertaining spaces and indoor sauna. Behind the laughter, wet feet and one-more-swim afternoons, the house keeps everything grounded. Living spaces hold the daily pattern. Bedrooms give everyone a place to land. The kitchen anchors movement between living, dining and the backyard. Lower-level spaces add flexibility for guests, work, play or longer stays. The supporting spaces keep the day going. The cabana and dressing area give pool days a proper landing zone: a place to change, drop a bag, reset between swims and stay outside longer. The wet bar keeps drinks, snacks and conversation close to the action. The guest suite gives visitors a reason to stay, and the indoor sauna brings warmth and comfort into colder months. Near the meeting point of Ballard, Fremont, Phinney and Greenwood, The Frelard Pool House keeps restaurants, breweries, parks, errands and transit close, while giving home its own reason to gather. A classic Seattle house with a way of living rarely found in the city.

This restored home has been thoroughly updated and still has old world charm. Just a few blocks to Salmon Bay Park and Loyal Heights Playfield. House sits on a quiet street with sidewalks. Basement has MIL/ADU with separate entrance and backyard has room for DADU (buyer to verify permitting). New roof with all new sheeting, new gutters, new paint inside and out. Refinished wood floors and beams, new kitchen cabinets, fresh landscaping. Modern mechanicals, double pane windows, updated lighting, solid wood trim. Off street parking and room for an RV. No HOA! Fenced back yard.

Investor Alert! Turnkey opportunity with immediate cash flow and future development potential. This fully occupied Duplex (600 sf Studio + 800 sf 1Bed 1Bath) + 1100 sf ADU (2 Bed 1 Bath) property generates stable rental income from day one, with all units leased. Zoned II U/125, the property offers investors the opportunity to collect income while evaluating redevelopment possibilities and maximizing the site's future value.

Storybook Tudor Charm in the Heart of Ballard. Nestled on a picturesque street filled with Old World charm and character, this enchanting 1931 Tudor welcomes you with timeless architectural details and distinctive craftsmanship. Inside, discover quarter-sawn oak floors, graceful archways, coved ceilings, an Art Deco fireplace, original millwork, mahogany doors, vintage hardware, and light-catching crystal doorknobs. The home offers two bedrooms plus an office, providing flexibility for working from home or creating a cozy personal retreat. Outside, a generous lot offers a private backyard and inviting patio, complete with raised garden beds-a peaceful oasis in the heart of the city. Enjoy the best of the Ballard lifestyle, with the famous Ballard Farmers Market, neighborhood shops, restaurants, and transit all within walking distance. Recent improvements include a new roof and gutters installed in 2025 and new interior paint throughout. An energy-efficient heat pump provides year-round comfort, with the added benefit of air conditioning. Non-conforming 3rd bedroom & large utility room with 2nd-bath conversion potential. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive. And apparently, the backyard has caught the attention of a local celebrity! Jimothy, the neighborhood's much-loved raccoon, has made an appearance on the Ring camera. Clearly, he has excellent taste in real estate.

Nestled behind a sylvan tree setting, this 1926 Ballard bungalow beckons to share its history. A gracious front garden and stoop open the door to 100 years of stories and memories with the eagerness to begin its next chapter. Original hardwoods and coved ceilings welcome cozying up to the fireplace with built ins for trinkets and artifacts of past and present. A bright cheerful kitchen spills into the sunroom style dining room with attached deck and view onto the expansive blank canvas backyard. 2 bedrooms and full vintage bathroom complete the main floor. Descend to the warm basement where possibilities are endless. media space, guest space, work from home? Full bathroom and (non-conforming) 3rd bedroom accessed through French doors. Huge detached shed at the end of the driveway offers ample storage and opportunities for art studio, home gym. What else can you dream and envision? All this just around the corner from the bustling epicenter of NW 65th St shops and eateries. And moments to Ballard, Phinney, or Greenwood. So many directions to choose from. which way will you explore today? tomorrow? and beyond? You've found it here in the heart of one of Seattle's most vibrant communities.

address: 1408 NW 64th St Apt B, Seattle, WA
text: Beautifully crafted townhome nestled in a peaceful setting in the heart of Ballard. The light-filled, open-concept main level features an inviting living room with a cozy gas fireplace and private balcony, flowing into the dining area and kitchen with breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, and gas range. The upper level offers two bedrooms with vaulted ceilings, a skylight, and a well-appointed full bath featuring dual vanities. The entry level includes a generously sized guest bedroom, full bath, and laundry room. Enjoy a fully fenced, private backyard, and an oversized attached one-car garage with abundant storage. Fresh interior paint, including all doors and trims, and no carpet throughout for easy maintenance. Unbeatable Ballard location just minutes from SLU and Downtown Seattle, with parks, grocery stores, fitness centers, restaurants, and neighborhood favorites just steps away.

address: 2440 NW 60th St Unit A, Seattle, WA
text: Zero carpet, zero vinyl: genuine hardwood and tile on every level of this 2019 Built Green rowhouse-style townhome-plus radiant heated floors, ductless mini-split A/C, and TWO decks, including a rooftop deck with City, Mountain & Territorial views. NO HOA, no dues, and dedicated off-street parking, all on a no-through-traffic dead-end street steps from the heart of Ballard. The chef's kitchen features a premium gas range and full appliance package; a tankless system delivers silent, even radiant heat plus endless hot water. Retreat to a primary suite with dual custom-organized closets and an oversized en-suite bath; the third bedroom flexes for guests or a home office. Freshly landscaped, partially fenced, and vacant for a quick, confident close. Walk & Bike Score 92 ("Walker's Paradise")-moments to the Sunday Ballard Farmers Market, top restaurants and shops, and the Ballard Community Center & playground. Move right in!

address: 2630 NW 58th St Unit C, Seattle, WA
text: NO HOA DUES! Experience the best of Ballard living in this stunning modern townhome where inside your home you experience style and privacy, while just outside your door awaits the active lifestyle you seek. Just three blocks from the Burke-Gilman Trail and Ballard Locks, you can run, bike or walk in minutes to Golden Gardens, Ballard's celebrated dining and shopping, transit and everything else this vibrant neighborhood has to offer. Step inside to a light-filled two-story great room with custom steel railings, polished concrete floors and blonde oak hardwood flooring. Upstairs, the stylish kitchen features custom modern cabinets, quartz countertops & a Bertazzoni gas range for the chef. A convenient half bath completes the level. Two spacious bedrooms, with ample closet space and a bath on the 3rd floor. But the real showstopper is upstairs-a PRIVATE ROOFTOP DECK! Create your own outdoor living room, host friends, dine under the stars or simply unwind while taking in views of the Ship Canal to the south and Puget Sound. Attached, private 1-car garage but you don't even need a car in with a WALKSCORE of 91! Steps to the popular Sunday Farmer's Market, The Majestic Bay Theater, parks, pubs, cafes, shops, restaurants & great live music venues. This home is immaculately maintained! Just move in and enjoy! NO HOA DUES!

text: Your own outdoor retreat in the heart of Ballard. A massive, south-facing private patio sets this one-bedroom condo apart, with generous space for summer BBQs, gardening, outdoor lounging with friends and pets, and taking in the fresh air of the PNW. Inside, hardwood floors and large windows create a warm, light-filled setting. New water heater, fresh paint and new carpet make it move-in ready, and distinctive art niches with accent lighting bring character and personality. The open layout connects space to cook, dine, and relax, with updated kitchen appliances and a gas cook-top. A cozy double-sided fireplace adds ambiance to both the living area and bedroom. Appreciate in-unit laundry, secure garage parking with EV charging, dedicated storage, elevator access, and city and water views from the rooftop deck. A professionally managed HOA with strong reserves adds peace of mind. Step out to QFC, neighborhood eateries, breweries, parks, and the Ballard Farmers Market. Discover the best of Ballard neighborhood living, with your own private outdoor oasis.

address: 5440 Leary Ave NW Unit 330, Seattle, WA
text: Walk everywhere from this Ballard retreat! Freshly updated with brand-new carpet, fresh paint, new lighting and fixtures, and a new washer and dryer. The fireplace and built-in kitchen island were removed to open up the space, and a new black kitchen cart conveys and rolls away for entertaining. This floor plan beats most junior 1-bedrooms in the building: room for a 4-top dining table and a full sofa, a more private bedroom, and a lovely view over the lushly landscaped courtyard and the lively street. Standout amenities include an on-site concierge and office manager, fitness center, sauna and spa, conference rooms, and community space, plus a secure, private courtyard for entertaining or quiet time. Steps to the Ballard Farmers Market, transit, groceries, and the best restaurants and bars. Well-funded HOA and a track record as a successful rental. Ideal as a primary home or pied-a-terre. Inspection and full disclosure package available on request.

Enjoy the best of Ballard from this beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 2-bath corner condo at Sterling Place. The south-facing unit opens onto a lovely courtyard that's private and fully fenced with room for outdoor dining and space for pets to play. Nicer appliances and butcher block countertops give the kitchen a warm, inviting feel, while custom tile work and engineered hardwood floors add character. The remodeled hall bathroom features radiant floor heating for extra comfort on chilly mornings. The home is nicely painted and includes a full-size washer and dryer. This intimate 10-unit community offers a secure underground parking space and dedicated storage for your gear. Ballard's shops, cafes, restaurants and award winning schools are just a short distance from your door, with Walk and Bike Scores in the high 90s. Welcome home!

Love the Ballard lifestyle! This top-floor end unit pairs an open layout with windows on three sides for great natural light and fresh breezes. Luxury vinyl plank flooring and fresh paint give the space a crisp, updated feel. Enjoy your own deck, full-size in-unit washer and dryer, and a dedicated parking spot. A smaller, well-managed building with low dues and no rental cap adds to the appeal. Just minutes from Ballard's favorite restaurants, shops and breweries, plus Golden Gardens, Shilshole Bay Marina, the Ballard Locks and the Ballard Nordic Museum. A great place to call home or add to your investment portfolio!
